# CANDIDATE: VWAP_SLOPE_RIBBON_ALIGN

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:**Filer: chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

A shift in VWAP slope aligned with a bullish/bearish EMA stack indicates a change in intraday money flow with higher follow‑through. This edge exists because VWAP slope change signals a shift in institutional money flow, and when aligned with a clear EMA ribbon (indicating a defined short-term trend), it increases the probability of sustained directional movement.

## Mechanism

Calculate VWAP slope as (VWAP_now – VWAP_5bars_ago)/5. Go long when VWAP slope crosses from ≤0 to >0 and EMA8 > EMA21 > EMA55; go short when slope crosses from ≥0 to <0 and EMA8 < EMA21 < EMA55, entering at the bar’s close. Exit shape: Stop at the most recent swing low (long) or swing high (short) using HH/LL structure; primary target at 1.5R; trail using a chandelier exit (ATR*3) after 1R. Regime hint: Optimal when VIX <25 and the ribbon shows clear separation (|EMA8‑EMA21| >0.1*price), indicating a defined short‑term trend.
